info_label.description: The MCP endpoint and where to manage its Music Assistant access tokens.

open_connect.label: Open Connect Wizard
open_connect.description: One-click setup for Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, VSCode, ChatGPT and other MCP clients. Mints a per-client token labelled `MCP — <Client>` (revocable in Profile → Long-lived access tokens) and copies the ready-to-paste snippet for you.

require_auth.label: Require authentication
require_auth.description: Require a fresh, enabled Music Assistant user and token for MCP requests. Keep authentication enabled for normal operation.

mount_path.label: Mount path
mount_path.description: HTTP path prefix where the MCP server is mounted on MA's webserver. Change only if it conflicts with another route.

enforce_audience.label: Enforce token audience (RFC 8707)
enforce_audience.description: Reject Bearer tokens whose `aud` claim does not match this MCP server's canonical URI. Mitigates the OAuth confused-deputy attack where a token issued for one MA endpoint is replayed against another. Requires upstream Music Assistant support for writing `aud` into JWTs (in progress) — until then enabling this rejects all existing tokens. Leave off unless your MA build issues audience-bound tokens.

extra_allowed_origins.label: Additional allowed Origins (CSV)
extra_allowed_origins.description: Comma-separated list of additional `Origin` headers to accept (e.g. `https://ha.example.com` for Home Assistant ingress, or a reverse-proxy hostname). By default the server only accepts `localhost`, `127.0.0.1`, the MA `base_url` host, and `publish_ip`. Mismatching Origins are rejected with 403 to mitigate DNS rebinding.

connect_external_url.label: Connect Wizard external URL (fallback)
connect_external_url.description: Optional explicit base URL the Connect Wizard should open at (e.g. `https://ha.example.com/<addon-slug>` for Home Assistant add-on ingress). Used only when the wizard cannot auto-detect the external URL from the active client connection — set it if your reverse proxy strips the `X-Forwarded-Host` / `X-Ingress-Path` headers.

trust_forwarded_proto.label: Trust reverse-proxy forwarded scheme
trust_forwarded_proto.description: Treat the Connect Wizard request as HTTPS when a trusted reverse proxy reports `X-Forwarded-Proto: https` (or `X-Forwarded-Scheme: https`), even though the proxy-to-MA hop is plain HTTP. Enable this only when MA sits behind a reverse proxy (nginx, Nginx Proxy Manager, Traefik, Caddy, ...) that terminates TLS and is configured to set this header and strip any client-supplied copy. Without it, the wizard refuses to mint credentials over the proxy because it sees plaintext HTTP from a non-loopback host. Leave OFF if MA is directly reachable — any LAN client could otherwise spoof the header.

debug_event_buffer_capacity.label: Debug: event buffer capacity
debug_event_buffer_capacity.description: Maximum number of recent events retained while at least one resolvable policy grants or confirms `debug:events`. Older events are dropped FIFO.

policy_default.label: Default policy
policy_default.description: Policy used when a token has no explicit override. Missing v2 configuration defaults to Read-only. Select Custom and enable Advanced mode to edit individual capability modes.

policy_token.description: Select Custom and enable Advanced mode to edit individual capability modes.

policy_manual_token_ids.label: Manual MCP token IDs
policy_manual_token_ids.description: Optional Music Assistant token IDs to configure when they cannot be discovered for the current settings user. Token IDs are not bearer secrets.

policy_token_suffixes.label: Stored token policy references
policy_token_suffixes.description: Internal non-reversible references that keep per-token policies available after restart. Bearer tokens and token IDs are never stored here.

res_library.label: Expose library:// resources
res_library.description: URI-addressable read-only views of artists, albums, tracks, playlists.

res_player.label: Expose player:// and queue:// resources
res_player.description: URI-addressable views of players and queues.

debug_inspect.label: Debug: inspect raw player/queue/provider state
debug_inspect.description: Exposes raw runtime state of players, queues, and providers via MCP. Intended for development and troubleshooting. Disable in production.

debug_logs.label: Debug: tail musicassistant.log
debug_logs.description: Allows MCP clients to read the tail of MA's log file with filters. Common token patterns are redacted. Intended for troubleshooting. Disable in production.

debug_events.label: Debug: read recent MA events
debug_events.description: Subscribes to MA's event bus at provider startup and exposes a ring buffer over MCP. Memory cost is bounded by the buffer capacity. Intended for troubleshooting. Disable in production.

debug_providers.label: Debug: inspect configured providers
debug_providers.description: Exposes provider state, masked configuration, registered webserver routes, installed package versions, and a health summary roll-up. Intended for troubleshooting. Disable in production.

debug_reload.label: Debug: reload a provider instance
debug_reload.description: Allows MCP clients to unload and reload provider instances, INTERRUPTING ANY ACTIVE STREAMS on the affected provider. Each call requires elicitation confirmation. Intended for provider-development iteration. Disable in production.

config_read.label: Config: read core/provider/player settings
config_read.description: Exposes read access to MA core, provider, and player configuration over MCP (secrets stay masked). Disable in production unless needed.

config_write_provider.label: Config: edit provider settings
config_write_provider.description: Allows MCP clients to change provider configuration and trigger provider config actions. Changes may reload the provider and interrupt its streams. Disable in production.

config_write_core.label: Config: edit core settings
config_write_core.description: Allows MCP clients to change MA core controller configuration (webserver, streams, cache, ...). Core changes may RESTART subsystems and interrupt ALL playback. Disable in production.

config_write_player.label: Config: edit player settings
config_write_player.description: Allows MCP clients to change per-player configuration and DSP. Disable in production.

config_write_secret.label: Config: allow writing secret values
config_write_secret.description: Required IN ADDITION to a category write flag before any SECURE_STRING (password/token) value can be written. With this off, secret writes are rejected while non-secret edits still work. Keep off unless deliberately rotating credentials.

connect.title: Connect an MCP client
connect.description: Open the Connect Wizard, choose your AI client and generate its Music Assistant configuration. Setup completes automatically when the configuration is ready.

manifest.description: Exposes Music Assistant as a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Claude, Codex, and other MCP-aware LLM clients.

errors.connect_wizard_unavailable: The Connect Wizard could not be opened; check the provider logs.
